matching_rule: Require exact documented contract identity and per-field semantics effective on 2026-09-10; explicit documented NOT_APPLICABLE is distinct from missing. Unknown session/trade universe remains INDETERMINATE.
source_precision: Retained H/I evidence reports two decimal places; this is not a proven contract tick-size or tolerance.
price_comparison: Exact Decimal numeric comparison without rounding, rescaling unless documented, or binary float. No unjustified tolerance.
quantity_comparison: Exact integers after documented units/multiplier alignment only; no guessed conversion.

classifications.AGREEMENT: All required identity/permission/provenance gates pass and the field semantics align, with exact numerical equality. Report lineage separately; numerical consistency is not semantic proof.
classifications.DISAGREEMENT: Same gates and comparable definitions, but unequal values. Preserve both reported values in ignored evidence only; neither source is presumed correct.
classifications.INDETERMINATE: Missing/unmatched/duplicate/adjusted/incompatible/ambiguous evidence or unresolved original field universe; no equality claim from similarly named fields.
classifications.NOT_EVALUATED: No authorized input or no applicable field. Missing settlement never replaced by close.

feed_lineage: DIRECT_COLLECTION, NSE_REDISTRIBUTION or UNKNOWN only if evidenced; unknown independence stays NOT_ESTABLISHED. Duplicate feeds cannot establish independence.
permitted_conclusions: Two-target field consistency only, never whole-date attribution, source qualification, consumer promotion or strategy sensitivity.
rule_amendment: Any later tolerance, identity, source, field, timing or scope change requires a new version approved before access; no tuning to pass observed results.
